newsitem.title: MEXICO: Televisa to refinance debt with $350 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Televisa to refinance debt with $350 mln loan.

text.p: Mexican media giant Grupo Televisa said Monday it had contracted a $350 million loan with Morgan Guaranty Trust Company of New York at an interest rate of floating 3-month LIBOR plus 0.45 percent to refinance outstanding debts.

"This loan is guaranteed with a portion of shares of PanAmSat Corp. and will be paid with a part of the cash transaction between PanAmSat and Hughes Corp.," Televisa said, refering to a previously announced upcoming deal between the companies.

"The loan as well as a portion of the monies received via the transaction...will be used to refinance debt of 3.4 billion pesos (nominal value) with Banco Nacional de Mexico SA (Banamex)," Televisa said, adding that debt was currently running at around 34 percent annually.
Banamex is the banking arm of Mexico's largest financial group Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival.
Televisa is selling its 40.5 percent stake in PanAmSat Corp. for about $600 million cash and an equity interest of about 8.5 percent in a new venture between PanAmSat and Hughes Electronics Corp.

In the deal, Televisa will also buy back PanAmSat's rights to purchase equity stakes in Televisa's Spanish broadcasting ventures in the Americas and in Spain. Televisa has valued this at $225 million.
